Date: 2026-11-15T09:03:00Z
Subject: Request: new-hire training & background evidence for SOC2 audit

Hi Marcus,

We're preparing the SOC 2 sampling for Acme Inc. and need documentation demonstrating your employee vetting and training processes for hires between 2025-09-01 and 2026-11-01. Specifically: 1) proof of background checks (redacted PII ok), 2) mandatory security training completion logs, 3) onboarding access provisioning timestamps, and 4) the checklist you use to clear new starters for production access.

Can you provide these artifacts or point us to a shared location? If any items are restricted, please let us know the process and expected timeline for evidence.

Thanks,
SecureAudit team

- Redacted background-check confirmations for the sample set (remove SSNs, DOBs; keep name + confirmation stamp). File name: background-checks-redacted-2026.pdf
- Training completion log export (include user id, course id, completion timestamp). File name: new-starter-training-log-2026.csv
- Access provisioning timestamps and approver (for prod accounts). File name: access-provisioning-timestamps.csv
- The standard starter clearance checklist (PDF). File name: starter-clearance-checklist.pdf

A couple of operational notes: follow the standard redaction SOP (shared in /hr/sops), and double-check that any contractors are flagged in the export. If you hit blockers with data retention windows, loop Vivek for escalation.

Thanks — I will assemble everything and upload to a shared Drive folder and send to SecureAudit.

-Marcus
